<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Warrior''' is the melee bruiser among the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes|classes]]: balanced physical stats, a strong stamina scaling and a passive that rewards long melee combos with stamina regeneration and defense penetration.
</translate>

<translate>
== Passive: Fury == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Landing '''3 consecutive unblocked melee hits''' grants '''1 Fury stack''', up to '''5'''.

<!--T:8-->
* Each stack gives '''+10% stamina regeneration'''.
* At '''5 stacks''' you also gain '''+10% defense penetration'''.
* A blocked hit resets the combo, and the combo also resets after 3 seconds without hits.
* Stacks refresh when you deal damage and fade after 5 seconds without dealing damage.

<!--T:9-->
Defense penetration lowers the defense of the target you hit; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Stats and Attributes|Stats and Attributes]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Starting stats and regeneration == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Starting stats:''' STR 10 · RES 5 · VIT 5
* '''Regeneration''' (per 5 seconds): health 1.75 (+0.06 per VIT) · Ki 4.0 (+0.08 per ENE) · stamina 12.0 (+0.045 per VIT, +0.06 per RES)
</translate>

<translate>
== Stat scaling == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
The Warrior's standout scaling is '''stamina''' (STM 1.6), backed by solid Strength (1.4) and Vitality (1.8). The VIT and DEF values grow on a curve as you invest more, up to 4 times the starting rate. Compare every class on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classes#Default stat scalings|Classes]] page.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
{{Config|Custom Races|stats.json}}
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
The class id is <code>warrior</code>. Its passive values (<code>comboHits</code>, <code>maxStacks</code>, <code>stmRegenPerStack</code>, <code>armorPenAtMax</code>, <code>stackDurationTicks</code> and <code>comboResetTicks</code>) are set per race in <code>races/&lt;race&gt;/stats.json</code>, together with the starting stats, scalings and regeneration.
</translate>
